scientific_integrity: The divisibility argument is exact. No claim is made that a_i is i-layered, nor that database non-detection proves global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Finite extension only: proves a_i=g_i for i=14,15,16,17, not for all i. Uses exact tabulated A023199/A073751 data for the minimal i-abundant inputs and colossally-abundant factor multiplicities.
title: Four further good-abundancy cases for the layered-number open question
